pull_request.head: codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype
pull_request.body:
Restore **1.8 mm barrel Pb** after the user authorized a larger annulus. Sampling radii are **1772.8–2350 mm**, with1248periods,50.18° inclination and all11original normalized radial compartment boundaries retained. Initial single LAr gaps return to~1.2mm. Warm outer radius **2641.7 mm** stays inside the original2830mm envelope. Explicit walls/vacuum/bath/service budgets are retained;650mm endcap XML/materials and the strict2.6mm control remain unchanged.

**Matched10,000 electrons/12workers and full readback pass:**8,544,489positive canonical hits,14.1min wall,3.543GiB peakRSS,21.408GB ROOT; no trimming. Source/analysis frozen at ec8815821a6530bbb6c6133332a5369d795b59f3. Same10–80GeV,flateta−3…3/fullphi primaries and fixed FTFP_BERT/0.7mmcuts/5mmcap,ECAL-onlyB0.

**The barrel penalty is partly recovered.** Held-out widths using the same fixed five-fold eta-forward-gain/refit-bootstrap diagnostic:

| Population | Original | Dense2.6mm | Restored1.8mm |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Inclusive | 13.12% | 6.00% | 3.74% |
| Core barrel, abs(eta)<1.2 | 2.43% | 4.30% | 3.04% |
| Transition,1.2–1.5 | 40.62% | 3.92% | 3.74% |
| Broad endcap,1.5–3 | 3.09% | 7.36% | 4.22% |

Core-barrel restored−dense is **−1.260pp [−1.437,−1.104]**; restored−original remains **+0.609pp [+0.482,+0.727]**, pointwise95%. Raw barrel widths are3.52/6.56/4.74%. The new geometry improves the dense control but does not preserve the original core precision. Both paired comparisons retain allzeros/tails,1000shared whole-event bootstraps, energy/direction/transition controls and underlying distributions. The fixed calibration uses5000fold refits per geometry per comparison, no invalid gains, ideal trutheta and no true-energy application input; exploratory conditional inference, no new family search.

Native component/union checks report0overlaps and minimum26.8001969samplingX0 over9088actual-period probes. Exact serial/12-thread24-event equality covers19065hits; both100-event step-policy pilots pass.45analysis plus3compact geometry tests pass. Separate SysArch, prospective PhysVal and final exact-revision PhysVal assessments found no material issues; the residual original-reference penalty remains explicit.

[Full results, raw distributions and SVG/PDF/PNG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-restored/README.md) · [Reproduction and source hashes](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-restored/reproduce.md) · [Evaluated fold models and separate full-fit reuse table](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/lar-compact-hadron-prototype/docs/validation/lar-restored/calibration-models.json)

The comparison is a geometry bundle, not isolated Pb causality; raw mixed-spectrum widths are not intrinsic reconstructed resolution. Cut convergence, digitization/pileup/radiation, actual ports/pressure/thermal/routing and multi-TeV containment remain open. ### Endcap depth amendment

The historical native package values around **24.7–25.1 X₀** include vessel walls, services and bath. Independent piece intersections give only about **21 X₀ sampling** over much of the interior. Moving that package axially alone would leave the depth requirement unmet.

- Warm front/back **5100 / 6210 mm**.

The deeper blade increases the inner-wheel Cartesian-versus-cylindrical taper discrepancy from **0.11685 to 0.19869 mm**. Preserve that approximation explicitly and verify native geometry, phase dependence and the transition.

### Evidence and interpretation

The [CMS calibration paper, §2/PDF4–5](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1306.2016) gives crystal lengths and radiation length corresponding to approximately **25.8/24.7 X₀** in barrel/endcap. This supports **25 X₀ as an unsigned nODD screening choice**, rather than proving sufficiency for every 14 TeV pp shower.

PDF text extraction emitted fontTools warnings; no layout verification or installation was performed.

**Precision is an unresolved test outcome.** The barrel proposal increases Pb thickness by 44.4%, reduces plane count by 8.33%, and substantially reduces active LAr path. Compare barrel and endcap energy-bin widths separately, alongside inclusive/angular means and tails: improved transition response could conceal worse barrel sampling precision.
